verdict.rationale: Teams docs confirm a built-in Copilot Chat assistant integrated directly in Teams and Outlook, capable of securely interacting with work/web data via Microsoft Graph, plus agent slash commands and prompt starters that let users delegate conversational tasks to it. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of successful task delegation (community evidence pack focuses on unrelated complaints/bugs, not Copilot capability), and more detail on the scope of tasks Copilot can autonomously execute vs. just answer.
